greeting: Well, well. A face I don't know, and I know all eleven faces on this island. Twelve, if you count the goat.
Welcome to Pebblenook, traveller. You've come a long way up. Your boots are still wet from the clouds.
seed: Hold on. What's that in your hand?
A seed... and it's glowing. Oh my. I haven't seen anything glow round here in a long, long while.
tree: See that tree, far off in the sky? That's the Great Tree. Mother of every tree there is.
Its roots hold our islands up. And when it's glad, that gladness spills out into the world, as colour, and music, and laughter.
promise: Long ago there was a promise. Each island gave the tree a gift, to keep it glad.
Rootholm gave water. Barkton gave strength. Leafwind gave breath. Seedhaven gave new life.
That old carving on our notice board shows it. I walk past it every day. I think it's mostly there to hold up the goat posters.
forgetting: But the tree's gladness faded, bit by bit. And as it did, so did ours.
We still hold the festivals, but nobody remembers why. And somewhere along the way, the gifts just... stopped.
fading: Now the colour is draining out of the world. Everyone's quiet. Tired, all the time.
And each of the four islands has a trouble of its own. They say the tree's first caretaker still wanders its roots, all alone. But they say a lot of things.
why_seed: That seed came from the Great Tree. Passed down in your family, you say? Then it remembers, even if we don't.
It glows when it's near an island that needs help. And right now, I'd wager, it's glowing for all of them.
what_to_do: Glide to the islands. Help them, and help them remember their gift.
Then perhaps the tree will be glad again. And perhaps we will be too.
launch: The launch point is just over there, on the edge. Hold on tight and don't look down. Or do, actually. The view's lovely.
Off you go. And do come back and tell me everything. I'll try to remember to ask.
